eval: (()=>{const g=__game,T=g.THREE;g.step(30);const r=g.eagle.rig;const S=r.sides[0];const base=Object.assign({},g.anim.pose.wingL);const out=[];for(const [k,vals] of [['droop',[-0.3,-0.15,0.15,0.3]],['handTwist',[-0.3,-0.15,0.15,0.3]],['digitFlex',[-0.2,0.3]],['foreTwist',[-0.2,0.2]],['armDroop',[-0.2,0.2]]]){for(const v of vals){const w=Object.assign({},base);w[k]=(base[k]||0)+v;r.setWing(0,w);r.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);const inv=r.trunk.matrixWorld.clone().invert();const P=(b)=>b.getWorldPosition(new T.Vector3()).applyMatrix4(inv);const pr=S.feathers.filter(f=>f.kind=='primary');const tip=(f)=>{const b=P(f.base),t=P(f.tip);return t.sub(b).multiplyScalar(2).add(b)};const a=tip(pr[7]),b=tip(pr[2]),wr=P(S.hand);out.push(k+' '+v+' p8 '+a.toArray().map(x=>x.toFixed(3))+' p3 '+b.toArray().map(x=>x.toFixed(3))+' wrist '+wr.toArray().map(x=>x.toFixed(3)))}}r.setWing(0,base);return out.join('\n')})()
